collision_audit.collision: Feature calculation and classification are coupled inside compute_signal; analyzers would recalc or reinterpret the same inputs if split naively.
collision_audit.guard: One FeatureSnapshot per pair/bar; analyzers receive immutable snapshot; snapshot hash logged with signal.

collision_audit.collision: Regime is detected, then TRENDING can be rewritten to RANGING on 4H conflict.
collision_audit.guard: Classifier is the only owner of regime; rewrites must emit classifier_reason; analyzers cannot mutate regime.

collision_audit.collision: TRENDING chooses SWING first, then FAST fallback, so style axis controls entry and stop policy inside regime logic.
collision_audit.guard: Remove style arbitration from analyzer outputs; one analyzer owns one regime contract and max_hold.

collision_audit.collision: RANGING has both base and recovery branches, but shares output contract with trend-like entries.
collision_audit.guard: Ranging analyzer emits only fade contracts; recovery/expansion routes to trend/impulse or NO_TRADE.

collision_audit.collision: VWAP veto runs after side selection and can nullify DRIFT/RANGING entries outside the analyzer that chose the side.
collision_audit.guard: Analyzer owns entry filters; orchestrator can only reject for global risk, not market thesis.

collision_audit.collision: SL/TP geometry lives in production signal computation, not in regime-specific contracts.
collision_audit.guard: SignalContract must carry entry/stop/exit_rule/max_hold; no downstream component recomputes geometry.

collision_audit.collision: max_hold is still derived from FAST/SWING style and night session, not regime personality.
collision_audit.guard: max_hold comes from analyzer namespace; session logic is an explicit analyzer parameter or global risk veto.

collision_audit.collision: Final entry_signal gate merges style, geometry, funding, OI, VWAP and RR into one boolean.
collision_audit.guard: Separate analyzer rejection reasons from orchestrator risk rejections; never collapse owners into one flag.

collision_audit.collision: 15m close handler computes main signal and stores last regime used by the 5m fade handler.
collision_audit.guard: 5m fade cannot inherit a mutable last regime; it must route from the same immutable classifier snapshot.

collision_audit.collision: Cooldown key uses symbol/regime/side but not analyzer ownership, while BB_FADE is special-cased.
collision_audit.guard: One pair -> one analyzer lock until expiry/close; cooldown namespace includes analyzer_id.

collision_audit.collision: Global breakeven_trail can override analyzer-specific exit semantics.
collision_audit.guard: Orchestrator may execute only follow rules embedded in SignalContract; global BE is disabled unless contract opts in.

collision_audit.collision: Snapshot stores generic entry/sl/tp fields, so different regime contracts lose exit-rule semantics.
collision_audit.guard: Persist full signal contract, including exit_rule and follow_rule, with schema_version.
